content.title: CHEN on Apple Music
content.text: SEP 29, 2025 Arcadia - EP 5 songs Descendants of the Sun, Pt. 2 (Original Television Soundtrack) - Single · 2016 Moonlovers: Scarlet Heart Ryeo (Original Television Soundtrack) · 2016 April, and a flower - The 1st Mini Album · 2019 Arcadia - EP · 2025 Dear my dear - The 2nd Mini Album - EP · 2019 It's Okay, That's Love, Pt. 1 (Original Television Soundtrack) - Single · 2014 One of the standout vocalists from the K-pop boy band EXO, CHEN has also wowed listeners with his own ballads and R&B releases. • A consistent collaborator throughout his career at SM Entertainment, CHEN has teamed up with numerous artists under the label umbrella, including his EXO bandmates. One of his most beloved songs, “For You,” features EXO's BAEKHYUN and XIUMIN. As part of the group S.M. THE BALLAD, he duetted with f(x)'s KRYSTAL and ZHANG LIYIN. • CHEN has grown as a songwriter throughout his career. He contributed lyrics to EXO singles like 2017’s “Ko Ko Bop” and 2018’s “Love Shot,” and to his own songs like “My Dear” and “Flower,” both released in 2019. • CHEN has also shown his versatility as a vocalist—like in 2016, when he teamed up with Alesso on the dance track “Years.” GENRE K-Pop
